input.goal: Create a single self-contained index.html: interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space (#060913) with central glowing star, orbiting planets with moons and trails, twinkling starfield, glassmorphism HUD controls, and click-spawned particle bursts.
constraints: Single file index.html, zero external dependencies (no external scripts, stylesheets, fonts, or images), valid JavaScript.

Body/canvas background color #060913; one <canvas id="sim"> filling the full window, resized on window resize, scaled by window.devicePixelRatio (canvas.width = innerWidth*dpr, ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)).
Animation loop uses requestAnimationFrame.
Central star drawn with ctx.createRadialGradient, with a corona whose radius/alpha pulses subtly over time (sin of time).

At least 5 planets, each with distinct orbital radius, angular speed and color; at least 3 moons total orbiting planets; planets have fading orbital trails (stored recent positions drawn with decreasing alpha).
Background starfield of at least 150 stars, each twinkling (alpha varies with sin of time and per-star phase).
HUD overlay div id="hud" with glassmorphism style: semi-transparent background rgba, backdrop-filter: blur(...), border, border-radius.
Button id="playPause" toggles pause; text 'Pause' when running, 'Play' when paused.
Button id="trailsToggle" toggles trails; text 'Trails: ON' / 'Trails: OFF'.
Button id="reset" resets simulation time to 0, planet angles to initial values, clears trails and burst particles.
Exactly: <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">; span id="speedVal" shows live multiplier like '1.0x' updated on input event.

Live readouts: span id="fps" (frames per second), span id="simTime" (simulation time in seconds, one decimal, advances by dt*speed only when not paused), span id="particleCount" (active burst particle count).

Clicking the canvas spawns a radial burst of at least 40 glowing particles at the click point (canvas CSS coordinates), each with velocity damped every frame (e.g. v *= 0.96) and life/alpha fading to 0, then removed.
Clicks on HUD must not spawn bursts (HUD is separate element above canvas; listen for click on canvas only).

Expose global window.app = { paused:boolean, trails:boolean, speed:number, simTime:number, particles:Array, planets:Array, moons:Array, stars:Array } kept in sync with state (same live objects/values; update window.app fields every frame or use getters).
Each planet object in app.planets has numeric fields radius (orbital radius), speed, angle and string field color; each moon in app.moons has a parent reference or parentIndex.
